change: Pause inherited processing below a CharacterSlot SubViewport while its Control is hidden; resume when visible.
renderer: Native Godot Compatibility with Mesa llvmpipe; diagnostic measurements, not a device FPS benchmark.
before: Hidden Home and six hidden job previews continue animation/process callbacks, although their viewports already stop GPU drawing.
after: Hidden animation clocks remain exactly zero across 60 engine process frames; all visible previews resume updates after showing again.
limitation: Removes small background CPU work. Hidden viewport GPU draw calls were already zero before the change; this is not a claim of a major overall frame-rate improvement.
scope: Hidden Home and job-preview CPU processing only; visible model geometry, materials and rendering settings are preserved.
